verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a test mode where the auth flow shows Stripe-managed test institutions that can be linked without credentials. A client-side `collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts` call is documented, and the official Stripe CLI and npm packages are referenced. A community user reports that 'Start Now' drops straight into the test dashboard, which suggests self-serve sandbox access. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of self-serve API key issuance, a runnable end-to-end quickstart, evidence of server-side client libraries across multiple languages, and hands-on time-to-first-link corroboration.
